Upscaled HUD: LunicAura106, https://nfsmods.xyz/mod/4319
Detailed Map: JeansBig, https://nfsmods.xyz/mod/4485
English Subtitles Fixed: VileStuff, https://nfsmods.xyz/mod/5286
High Quality Vinyls & Doorlines: AdrienShadow, https://nfsmods.xyz/mod/8064

Local optional packs use the NTXP conversion published by th0mk/nfsu2-web,
https://github.com/th0mk/nfsu2-web, commit
16b23865f09dc41b9533635180e6d3fd34c45a6d.
Artwork remains the work of its respective authors, under their respective
terms. The MIT license for the decoder does not relicense the artwork.
Original game assets and converted artwork are not part of this source tree.

Native vinyl packs decode the optional HQV1 artwork to losslessly compressed
NHQ1 pixel planes. The native compositor follows the integer blending and
original gloss preservation documented in nfsu2-web's web/src/gpu/hqskin.ts.
